assertions.reason: Every phase 1 goal in plan ('Hands-on 2–3 h, review and verify 2–3 h, total 4–6 h') and every ticket front matter (estimate: hands_on / review_and_verify / total, '# human hours, agent-assisted') gives ranges split hands-on vs review; phase 2 goals carry totals only.
Tickets G01–G05 totals equal plan goals; plan states 'Phase 1 adds up to 4–6 + 3–5 + 4–6 + 3–5 + 4–6 = 18–28 hours' vs 36 h less 8 h reserve (22%) = 28 h, 'even the high end fits'.

Each goal/ticket has a separate 'Calendar wait' / calendar_waits field: Atlassian token 1–3 days, helpdesk lead's hour, IAP group 0–2 days, 3 working days of pilot use; G04 'none'; 'Start on day 1 (calendar waits)' list in plan.
Plan person table: Engineer A G01,G02,half G05 = 9–14 vs ~14; Engineer B G03,G04,half G05 = 9–14 vs ~14; 'Longest dependent chain: G01 → G04 → G05 = 11–17 hours'; owners in each ticket.

A.arithmetic: Goals: G01 4–6, G02 3–5, G03 4–6, G04 3–5, G05 4–6; sum 18–28 = stated 18–28. Split sums all check (G01 2–3+2–3, G02 2–3+1–2, G03 1.5–2.5+2.5–3.5, G04 1–2+2–3, G05 2.5–3.5+1.5–2.5). Capacity 2×0.5×10×6×0.6 = 36; reserve 8 (22%) -> 28; high end 28 = 28, fits with zero slack beyond reserve. Tickets match goals exactly (totals and splits). Per person: A = 4–6+3–5+2–3 = 9–14; B = 4–6+3–5+2–3 = 9–14; each vs ~14 (28/2) - consistent. Chain G01->G04->G05 = 4–6+3–5+4–6 = 11–17 (G03->G04->G05 equal length; not mentioned but harmless). No mismatches.
A.least_believable_estimate: G05 at 4–6 h: container, service account, Cloud Run, IAP, Firestore TTL, budget alert, log policy, rollback demo and collecting pilot feedback from 3+ technicians is tight even reusing a template; G04 at 3–5 h (IAP JWT middleware, session ownership, static page, state_delta) is also on the low side.
